artifacts.title: Routing Ad Interim Committee Recommendations Through Overtures Committee

matches.evidence: The CCB found Calvary Presbytery's overture requiring ad interim committee recommendations to go through the Overtures Committee in conflict with BCO 14-1.15 and productive of procedural ambiguity on the GA floor.

artifacts.title: Overture requiring all BCO changes referred to CCB and Bills and Overtures

matches.evidence: The CCB found this overture in conflict with RAO 13-1 and BCO 14-1, which permit BCO amendments of a particular nature to be referred to other committees and allow proposals to arise from other Assembly reports.
